#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Concatenate this repository's files into one text bundle.

For moving the project somewhere that cannot clone it: copy the bundle (and
tools/unpack_repo.py) across as text, then run unpack_repo.py to rebuild the
directory tree.

  python3 tools/pack_repo.py                      # -> drawlogic_bundle.txt
  python3 tools/pack_repo.py -o out.txt
  python3 tools/pack_repo.py --split 400000       # parts of ~400 KB each
  python3 tools/pack_repo.py --exclude 'benchmarks/*' --exclude 'tests/golden/*'

Which files: everything git tracks (`git ls-files`), so the copy is the same
project the repository is -- manifest.txt lists the files `drawlogic doctor`
checks, and a bundle missing some would fail it. Without git, every file under
the root except the usual junk (.git, __pycache__, ...). Binary files are
skipped with a warning; this project has none.

Each file sits between two marker lines:

  <<<<<<<<<< DLBUNDLE BEGIN path=drawlogic/doc.py lines=812 sha256=... >>>>>>>>>>
  ...the file, unchanged...
  <<<<<<<<<< DLBUNDLE END path=drawlogic/doc.py >>>>>>>>>>

The line count and hash let the unpacker say exactly which file a copy-paste
damaged, instead of leaving a subtly broken tree. Stdlib only, Python 3.9+.
"""

import argparse
import fnmatch
import hashlib
import os
import subprocess
import sys

FORMAT = "DLBUNDLE v1"
OPEN = "<<<<<<<<<< "
CLOSE = " >>>>>>>>>>"
SKIP_DIRS = {".git", "__pycache__", ".pytest_cache", "node_modules", ".venv", "venv"}


def tracked_files(root):
  """Paths relative to root, '/'-separated, sorted."""
  try:
    out = subprocess.run(["git", "ls-files", "-z"], cwd=root, check=True,
                         stdout=subprocess.PIPE, stderr=subprocess.DEVNULL).stdout
    return sorted(p for p in out.decode("utf-8").split("\0") if p)
  except (OSError, subprocess.CalledProcessError):
    found = []
    for folder, dirs, files in os.walk(root):
      dirs[:] = [d for d in dirs if d not in SKIP_DIRS]
      for name in files:
        rel = os.path.relpath(os.path.join(folder, name), root)
        found.append(rel.replace(os.sep, "/"))
    return sorted(found)


def read_text(path):
  """The file's text, or None if it is binary or not UTF-8."""
  with open(path, "rb") as handle:
    data = handle.read()
  if b"\0" in data:
    return None
  try:
    return data.decode("utf-8")
  except UnicodeDecodeError:
    return None


def section(rel, text):
  """One file as it goes into the bundle, ending in a newline."""
  digest = hashlib.sha256(text.encode("utf-8")).hexdigest()
  lines = text.count("\n") + (0 if text.endswith("\n") or not text else 1)
  # A file without a final newline gets one in the bundle, so its END marker
  # starts a line; `eol=no` tells the unpacker to take it off again.
  eol = "" if text.endswith("\n") or not text else " eol=no"
  body = text if text.endswith("\n") or not text else text + "\n"
  return ("%sDLBUNDLE BEGIN path=%s lines=%d sha256=%s%s%s\n%s%sDLBUNDLE END path=%s%s\n"
          % (OPEN, rel, lines, digest, eol, CLOSE, body, OPEN, rel, CLOSE))


def main():
  here = os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__))
  parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__.split("\n\n")[0])
  parser.add_argument("--root", default=os.path.dirname(here),
                      help="repository root (default: the folder above tools/)")
  parser.add_argument("-o", "--output", default="drawlogic_bundle.txt",
                      help="bundle file to write (default: drawlogic_bundle.txt)")
  parser.add_argument("--exclude", action="append", default=[], metavar="GLOB",
                      help="leave out paths matching this glob; may repeat")
  parser.add_argument("--split", type=int, default=0, metavar="BYTES",
                      help="write several parts of about this size instead of one "
                           "file (a file is never cut in two)")
  args = parser.parse_args()

  root = os.path.abspath(args.root)
  output = os.path.abspath(args.output)
  sections = []
  for rel in tracked_files(root):
    path = os.path.join(root, rel)
    if os.path.abspath(path) == output or not os.path.isfile(path):
      continue
    if fnmatch.fnmatch(os.path.basename(rel), "drawlogic_bundle*.txt"):
      continue  # a committed bundle must not be packed inside the next one
    if any(fnmatch.fnmatch(rel, pattern) for pattern in args.exclude):
      continue
    text = read_text(path)
    if text is None:
      print("skipped (binary or not UTF-8): %s" % rel, file=sys.stderr)
      continue
    sections.append((rel, section(rel, text)))

  # Group into parts: one part unless --split asks for several.
  parts = [[]]
  size = 0
  for rel, chunk in sections:
    if args.split and parts[-1] and size + len(chunk) > args.split:
      parts.append([])
      size = 0
    parts[-1].append((rel, chunk))
    size += len(chunk)

  stem, ext = os.path.splitext(output)
  written = []
  for index, part in enumerate(parts, 1):
    name = output if len(parts) == 1 else "%s.part%03d%s" % (stem, index, ext or ".txt")
    header = ("%s%s part=%d/%d files=%d%s\n"
              "# Rebuild with: python3 unpack_repo.py %s\n"
              % (OPEN, FORMAT, index, len(parts), len(part), CLOSE,
                 os.path.basename(name) if len(parts) == 1
                 else os.path.basename(stem) + ".part*" + (ext or ".txt")))
    with open(name, "w", encoding="utf-8", newline="\n") as handle:
      handle.write(header)
      for _rel, chunk in part:
        handle.write(chunk)
    written.append(name)

  total = sum(os.path.getsize(name) for name in written)
  print("packed %d files into %s (%d bytes)"
        % (len(sections), ", ".join(os.path.relpath(n) for n in written), total))


if __name__ == "__main__":
  main()

<<<<<<<<<< DLBUNDLE BEGIN path=tools/unpack_repo.py lines=155 sha256=be00c3b8281fc780f30c1794402e199029bc40a03803d2f2520f2aa0bc3f246a >>>>>>>>>>
#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Rebuild the repository's directory tree from a bundle made by pack_repo.py.

  python3 unpack_repo.py drawlogic_bundle.txt                  # into ./drawlogic
  python3 unpack_repo.py drawlogic_bundle.txt -d some/folder
  python3 unpack_repo.py bundle.part001.txt bundle.part002.txt ...
  python3 unpack_repo.py drawlogic_bundle.txt --check          # verify only

Every file is checked against the line count and SHA-256 written beside it
when it was packed. A copy-paste that dropped a line, wrapped one, or changed
tabs or trailing spaces is reported by file name, and the run exits non-zero.
Windows line endings picked up on the way are taken off before checking, since
the originals have none.

Stdlib only, Python 3.9+, and self-contained: copy this one file across with
the bundle.
"""

import argparse
import glob
import hashlib
import os
import re
import sys

BEGIN = re.compile(r"^<{10} DLBUNDLE BEGIN path=(?P<path>.+?) lines=(?P<lines>\d+) "
                   r"sha256=(?P<sha>[0-9a-f]{64})(?P<noeol> eol=no)? >{10}$")
END = "<<<<<<<<<< DLBUNDLE END path=%s >>>>>>>>>>"
HEADER = re.compile(r"^<{10} DLBUNDLE v1 part=(?P<part>\d+)/(?P<parts>\d+) "
                    r"files=(?P<files>\d+) >{10}$")


def safe_target(root, rel):
  """Where `rel` goes under root, refusing anything that would land outside it."""
  if rel.startswith(("/", "\\")) or re.match(r"^[A-Za-z]:", rel):
    raise ValueError("absolute path in bundle: %s" % rel)
  target = os.path.normpath(os.path.join(root, *rel.split("/")))
  if os.path.commonpath([os.path.abspath(root), os.path.abspath(target)]) \
      != os.path.abspath(root):
    raise ValueError("path escapes the target folder: %s" % rel)
  return target


def read_sections(paths, expected):
  """Yield (path, text, expected_lines, expected_sha, problems) per file.

  `expected` is filled in from the headers: {"files": n, "parts": {i, ...},
  "of": total parts}, so a lost part or a cut-off paste is noticed even where
  nothing is left of the files it held.
  """
  for bundle in paths:
    with open(bundle, "r", encoding="utf-8", newline="") as handle:
      lines = handle.read().split("\n")
    lines = [line[:-1] if line.endswith("\r") else line for line in lines]
    header = HEADER.match(lines[0]) if lines else None
    if not header:
      print("warning: %s does not start with a DLBUNDLE header" % bundle,
            file=sys.stderr)
    else:
      expected["files"] += int(header.group("files"))
      expected["parts"].add(int(header.group("part")))
      expected["of"] = int(header.group("parts"))
    index = 0
    while index < len(lines):
      match = BEGIN.match(lines[index])
      index += 1
      if not match:
        continue
      rel = match.group("path")
      closing = END % rel
      body = []
      while index < len(lines) and lines[index] != closing:
        if BEGIN.match(lines[index]):
          break
        body.append(lines[index])
        index += 1
      problems = []
      if index >= len(lines) or lines[index] != closing:
        problems.append("no END marker -- the bundle was cut off here")
      else:
        index += 1
      text = "\n".join(body) + ("\n" if body else "")
      if match.group("noeol") and text.endswith("\n"):
        text = text[:-1]
      yield rel, text, int(match.group("lines")), match.group("sha"), problems


def main():
  parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__.split("\n\n")[0])
  parser.add_argument("bundles", nargs="+",
                      help="bundle file(s); parts are read in name order")
  parser.add_argument("-d", "--dest", default="drawlogic",
                      help="folder to rebuild into (default: ./drawlogic)")
  parser.add_argument("--check", action="store_true",
                      help="verify the bundle without writing anything")
  parser.add_argument("--force", action="store_true",
                      help="write files that fail their check anyway")
  args = parser.parse_args()

  paths = []
  for pattern in args.bundles:
    matched = sorted(glob.glob(pattern))
    paths.extend(matched or [pattern])

  dest = os.path.abspath(args.dest)
  written = bad = 0
  seen = set()
  expected = {"files": 0, "parts": set(), "of": 0}
  for rel, text, want_lines, want_sha, problems in read_sections(paths, expected):
    if rel in seen:
      problems.append("appears twice in the bundle")
    seen.add(rel)
    got_lines = text.count("\n") + (0 if text.endswith("\n") or not text else 1)
    if got_lines != want_lines:
      problems.append("%d lines, expected %d" % (got_lines, want_lines))
    elif hashlib.sha256(text.encode("utf-8")).hexdigest() != want_sha:
      problems.append("content changed (line count is right: look for altered "
                      "tabs, trailing spaces or characters)")
    if problems:
      bad += 1
      print("BAD  %s: %s" % (rel, "; ".join(problems)), file=sys.stderr)
      if not args.force:
        continue
    if args.check:
      continue
    target = safe_target(dest, rel)
    os.makedirs(os.path.dirname(target), exist_ok=True)
    with open(target, "w", encoding="utf-8", newline="\n") as handle:
      handle.write(text)
    written += 1

  if not seen:
    print("no files found -- is this a DLBUNDLE file?", file=sys.stderr)
    sys.exit(1)
  missing_parts = sorted(set(range(1, expected["of"] + 1)) - expected["parts"])
  if missing_parts:
    bad += 1
    print("BAD  part(s) %s of %d not given" % (
      ", ".join(map(str, missing_parts)), expected["of"]), file=sys.stderr)
  if len(seen) < expected["files"]:
    bad += 1
    print("BAD  the headers promise %d files but only %d were found -- the rest "
          "were cut off" % (expected["files"], len(seen)), file=sys.stderr)
  if args.check:
    print("%d files checked, %d bad" % (len(seen), bad))
  else:
    print("wrote %d of %d files into %s%s"
          % (written, len(seen), dest, "" if not bad else
             " -- %d failed their check%s" % (bad, ", written anyway" if args.force
                                               else " and were not written")))
  sys.exit(1 if bad else 0)


if __name__ == "__main__":
  main()

# Check that this copy of drawlogic has the files it should, on Windows.
#
#   powershell -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File verify.ps1
#
# Run it from the folder that contains manifest.txt -- the top of the repo --
# or point it anywhere with -Root. It reads manifest.txt, hashes each file it
# names, and reports MATCH (with the file's size), MISMATCH, MISSING or EXTRA.
#
# Line endings and trailing blank lines are made uniform before hashing,
# exactly as drawlogic/cli.py does it, so a file is only "wrong" when what it
# says is different. Git rewrites line endings on checkout by default on
# Windows, and a byte-for-byte check reports every file in a perfectly good
# clone as broken -- which is what happened the first time one of these was
# handed over: all 28 files "mismatched" and not one of them actually
# different. Copying a file by hand from a browser has the same effect on the
# newline at the end of the file. A checker that cries wolf is worse than
# none, because the next real mismatch gets ignored too.
#
# Works on Windows PowerShell 5.1 and on PowerShell 7+.

[CmdletBinding()]
param(
    [string]$Root = $PSScriptRoot,
    [string]$Manifest
)

$ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop'

if (-not $Root) { $Root = (Get-Location).Path }
# Resolved once, so the relative paths worked out below cannot be thrown off
# by a trailing separator or by how the folder was spelled on the way in.
$Root = (Resolve-Path -LiteralPath $Root).Path.TrimEnd('\', '/')
if (-not $Manifest) { $Manifest = Join-Path $Root 'manifest.txt' }

if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $Manifest)) {
    Write-Host "No manifest.txt at $Manifest" -ForegroundColor Red
    Write-Host "Run this from the top of the drawlogic folder, or pass -Root."
    exit 2
}

# UTF-8 without a byte order mark, which is what File.ReadAllText writes back
# out and what the Python side hashes.
$utf8 = New-Object System.Text.UTF8Encoding($false)
$sha = [System.Security.Cryptography.SHA256]::Create()

function Get-ContentHash([string]$Path) {
    # ReadAllText with a UTF-8 encoding strips a byte order mark if there is
    # one, so a file saved by Notepad hashes the same as one saved by anything
    # else.
    $text = [System.IO.File]::ReadAllText($Path, $utf8)
    $text = $text -replace "`r`n", "`n"
    $text = $text -replace "`r", "`n"
    # A file pasted by hand from a browser routinely gains or loses the
    # newline at the very end without anything else having changed, so one
    # trailing newline hashes the same as none or several -- exactly as
    # drawlogic/cli.py does it.
    $text = $text.TrimEnd("`n")
    if ($text.Length -gt 0) { $text = $text + "`n" }
    $bytes = $utf8.GetBytes($text)
    return ([System.BitConverter]::ToString($sha.ComputeHash($bytes)) -replace '-', '').ToLowerInvariant()
}

$ok = 0
$bad = New-Object System.Collections.ArrayList
$listed = New-Object System.Collections.Generic.HashSet[string]

foreach ($line in Get-Content -LiteralPath $Manifest) {
    $line = $line.Trim()
    if (-not $line -or $line.StartsWith('#')) { continue }
    if ($line -notmatch '^([0-9a-fA-F]{64})\s+(.+)$') { continue }

    $expected = $Matches[1].ToLowerInvariant()
    $relative = $Matches[2].Trim()
    [void]$listed.Add($relative)

    # Forward slashes as the manifest writes them: .NET accepts them on
    # Windows too, so there is nothing to translate and nothing to get wrong.
    $full = Join-Path $Root $relative
    if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $full -PathType Leaf)) {
        Write-Host "MISSING   $relative" -ForegroundColor Red
        [void]$bad.Add($relative)
        continue
    }

    try {
        $actual = Get-ContentHash $full
    } catch {
        Write-Host "UNREADABLE $relative -- $($_.Exception.Message)" -ForegroundColor Red
        [void]$bad.Add($relative)
        continue
    }

    if ($actual -eq $expected) {
        $ok++
        # The size is of the file as it sits on disk, not of the normalised
        # text that was hashed -- it is here so a MATCH still says something
        # concrete about the file, the same way MISMATCH names the file that
        # differs rather than just counting it.
        $size = (Get-Item -LiteralPath $full).Length
        Write-Host ("MATCH     {0}  ({1:N0} bytes)" -f $relative, $size) -ForegroundColor Green
    } else {
        Write-Host "MISMATCH  $relative" -ForegroundColor Yellow
        [void]$bad.Add($relative)
    }
}

# A file the manifest has never heard of is worth saying so: it is usually a
# leftover from an older version that Python will happily import instead of
# the one meant to be there.
$package = Join-Path $Root 'drawlogic'
if (Test-Path -LiteralPath $package) {
    $prefix = $Root + [System.IO.Path]::DirectorySeparatorChar
    foreach ($file in Get-ChildItem -LiteralPath $package -Recurse -File) {
        if ($file.Extension -eq '.pyc' -or $file.Extension -eq '.pyo') { continue }
        if ($file.FullName -like '*__pycache__*') { continue }
        if (-not $file.FullName.StartsWith($prefix)) { continue }
        $relative = $file.FullName.Substring($prefix.Length) -replace '\\', '/'
        if (-not $listed.Contains($relative)) {
            Write-Host "EXTRA     $relative" -ForegroundColor Yellow
            [void]$bad.Add($relative)
        }
    }
}

Write-Host ""
if ($bad.Count -eq 0) {
    Write-Host "$ok files, all as they should be" -ForegroundColor Cyan
    exit 0
}

Write-Host "$ok files as they should be, $($bad.Count) not" -ForegroundColor Cyan
Write-Host ""
Write-Host "Files from different versions of drawlogic cannot work together."
Write-Host "Take the whole repository at once rather than file by file:"
Write-Host "  git clone https://github.com/ssaurabh41/drawlogic"
Write-Host "or download and unzip"
Write-Host "  https://github.com/ssaurabh41/drawlogic/archive/refs/heads/main.zip"
exit 1
